title: Laravel (PHP + Composer)
description: Backend starter: PHP, Composer and the Laravel installer, installed in your home folder with the official php.new script. No administrator password needed.
author: Tux Store

info.note: Sizes are approximate. Installed with the official php.new script (Laravel Herd Lite) into ~/.config/herd-lite/bin.

welcome.title: Laravel development setup
message: This installs PHP, Composer and the Laravel installer using the official php.new script.
• Everything goes into ~/.config/herd-lite/bin — no administrator password is needed.
• Two lines are added to your shell profile (~/.bashrc or ~/.zshrc) so php, composer and laravel work in the terminal.
• This PHP will be used before any PHP installed with pacman.

command.label: Looking for an existing php.new install…

already.title: Already installed
message: PHP from php.new was found in ~/.config/herd-lite/bin.
Continuing will download and overwrite php, composer and laravel there (a good way to update or choose another PHP version).

options.label: PHP 8.5
options.hint: Newest. If you see deprecation warnings from the laravel installer, reinstall with 8.4.

confirm.title: Ready to install
message: PHP ${php_version}, Composer and the Laravel installer will be downloaded from php.new and installed in ~/.config/herd-lite/bin.
Your shell profile gets two PATH lines (they are removed again on Uninstall).

run.title: Installing…
run.message: Downloading PHP, Composer and the Laravel installer. Please keep the computer on.

install_failed.title: Installation failed
message: Something went wrong while installing.
${last_output}
Nothing was recorded, so you can simply try again.

done.title: Laravel tools are ready
message: PHP ${installed_version} installed.
${tools_msg}
Open a NEW terminal (or run: source ~/.bashrc  /  source ~/.zshrc), then try:
laravel new example-app
cd example-app && composer run dev
Tips:
• Vite / npm needs Node.js:  sudo pacman -S nodejs npm
• fish shell: add the folder yourself with  fish_add_path ~/.config/herd-lite/bin

un_confirm.title: Remove PHP, Composer and Laravel?
message: This deletes: ${recorded_files}
and removes the two PATH lines from your shell profiles (a .tux-store-backup copy is kept next to each changed file).
Your Laravel projects and your global Composer packages are not touched.

un_failed.title: Removal failed
message: Could not remove everything.
${last_output}
The install record was kept, so you can try again.

un_done.title: Removed
un_done.message: PHP, Composer and the Laravel installer from php.new were removed. Open a new terminal so the old PATH is gone.
